zh-Hant.tagline: 發帖分享 × AI 酒吧
zh-Hant.title: WhatToDrink — 發帖分享，和 Ivy 玩大話骰
zh-Hant.description: 拍照發帖，分享你的微醺日常；走進 3D 酒吧，與 AI 酒保 Ivy 聊天、玩大話骰和 21 點。
zh-Hant.screenshotNote: 依實際功能設計 · 示範內容
zh-Hant.responsible: 18+ · 理性飲酒，切勿酒後駕駛

hero.title: 照片，發成帖子。
hero.sub:
拍照、發帖，留下你的微醺日常。
走進 3D 酒吧，和 AI 酒保 Ivy 聊天、玩大話骰。

end.title: 你的微醺日常。
end.sub: 發帖分享、酒吧聊天、大話骰。打開 App，就是今晚的開始。

capture.title: 今晚，值得拍下來。
capture.sub:
拍下眼前的一杯，或從相簿選圖。
在「分享今晚」選擇帖子，把這個片刻留下。
capture.detail: 拍照或從相簿選圖 · 帖子永久保留

edit.title: 調好照片。
edit.sub:
用濾鏡、調整和裁切整理畫面。
加上文字、酒類標籤與地點，讓照片說得更多。
edit.detail: 濾鏡 · 調整 · 裁切 · 文字 · 酒類標籤 · 地點

publish.title: 預覽這一刻。
publish.sub:
確認照片、地點和酒類標籤。
選擇誰看得到，再按「發布帖子」。
publish.detail: 公開 · 好友 · 僅自己
publish.focus: 確認可見範圍，發布帖子

map.title: 一張照片。
map.sub:
帖子出現在地圖上，也留在你的足跡。
打開詳情，回看照片，與酒友交流。
map.detail: 地圖上的帖子 · 照片詳情 · 碰杯與留言

ivy.title: 一間 3D 酒吧。
ivy.sub:
走進 What to Drink Bar，和 Ivy 說話。
聊聊今晚想喝什麼，或直接邀她玩一局。
ivy.detail: 與 Ivy 聊天 · 大話骰 · 21 點
ivy.focus: 酒吧內的真實遊戲入口

cocktail.title: 從一份酒譜開始。
cocktail.sub:
選酒譜、確認材料與份量，再一步步跟著做。
每步都有配圖和 Ivy 提示；有疑問可以問 Ivy，完成再拍照分享。
cocktail.detail: 選酒譜 → 看配方 → 跟住做 → 完成分享
cocktail.focus: 材料、步驟、Ivy 提示與完成入口

dice.title: 搖骰，偷看。
dice.sub:
每人 5 粒骰，按住偷看自己的骰子。
叫骰、開盅，和 Ivy 比一比誰更會唬。
dice.detail: 按住說話，叫骰　／　按住偷看　／　開盅

party.title: 今晚的酒局。
party.sub:
按日期、空位和 AA 制篩選。
打開詳情，確認時間、地點和發起人，再決定是否加入。
party.detail: 探索 → 酒局詳情 → 參加酒局

trail.title: 走過的地方。
trail.sub:
按日期回看照片和地點，再打開足跡地圖。
預覽各站，跟著腳印回放；可以暫停、切換站點和調整速度。
trail.detail: 日期篩選 → 照片記錄 → 地圖預覽 → 腳印回放
trail.focus: 地圖站點、腳印路徑與播放控制

meet.eyebrow: 遇見 / 用一句話搜尋
meet.title: 說出你想找的。
meet.sub:
找用戶、酒吧、酒局或帖子。
用文字或語音描述，查看理解的條件與搜尋結果。
meet.detail: 描述需求 → 確認條件 → 查看結果

tonight.eyebrow: 今晚喝什麼 / 一點靈感
tonight.title: 還未決定？
tonight.sub:
揭曉今晚的酒類，再抽一次也可以。
接著找附近酒吧及便利店，或約人同飲。
tonight.detail: 抽選 → 揭曉 → 附近去處／約人
tonight.focus: 抽選之後，下一步就在這裡

cheers.title: 喜歡這個片刻。
cheers.sub:
在帖子上向酒友碰杯。
查看收到與送出的碰杯，回敬一杯，再聊聊。
cheers.detail: 帖子碰杯 → 收到回應 → 回敬／聊天
cheers.focus: 收到、送出和回敬各有記錄

home.title: 從地圖出發。
home.sub:
地圖連起帖子、約局和附近。
個人主頁整理你的打卡、足跡、收藏與口味。
home.detail: 主地圖 → 個人主頁 → 打卡／足跡／收藏
home.focus: 你的資料與口味，一處整理

en.title: WhatToDrink — Share your night. Play Liar’s Dice with Ivy.
en.description: Share your night with photo posts. Step into a 3D bar to chat and play Liar’s Dice or blackjack with Ivy, your AI bartender.
en.responsible: 18+ · Enjoy responsibly. Never drink and drive.

hero.title: Your photo. Your post.
hero.sub:
Share your night in photo posts.
Chat and play Liar’s Dice with Ivy, your AI bartender, in a 3D bar.

end.title: A night to share.
end.sub: Photo posts. Bar conversations. Liar’s Dice. Your night starts here.

capture.title: A night worth a photo.
capture.sub:
Take a photo or choose one from your library.
Select Post in Share Tonight to keep the moment.
capture.detail: Camera or photo library · Permanent posts

edit.title: Make it your photo.
edit.sub:
Filter, adjust and crop your photo.
Add your words, drink tags and a place.
edit.detail: Filter · Adjust · Crop · Text · Drink tags · Place

publish.title: One last look.
publish.sub:
Check your photo, place and drink tags.
Choose who can see it, then tap Publish Post.

map.title: A photo becomes
map.sub:
Your post appears on the map and stays in your trail.
Open it to revisit the photo and connect with others.
map.detail: Posts on the map · Photo details · Cheers and comments
map.focus: Open the photo post from the map

ivy.title: A 3D bar.
ivy.sub:
Step into What to Drink Bar and talk to Ivy.
Chat about your next drink, or invite her to a game.
ivy.detail: Chat with Ivy · Liar’s Dice · Blackjack
ivy.focus: Actual game entries inside the bar

cocktail.title: Start with a recipe.
cocktail.accent: A little help at every step.
cocktail.sub:
Choose a recipe, check ingredients and servings, then follow along.
Each step has an illustration and an Ivy tip. Ask Ivy, then photograph your creation.
cocktail.focus: Ingredients, illustrated steps, Ivy tips and sharing

dice.title: Shake. Peek.
dice.sub:
Five dice each. Hold to peek at your own dice.
Make a bid or call the bluff. Can you outplay Ivy?
dice.detail: Voice bidding · Hold to peek · Call the bluff

party.title: A plan for tonight.
party.sub:
Filter by date, open seats and split bills.
Check the time, place and host before joining.

trail.title: Places you’ve been.
trail.sub:
Revisit photos and places by date, then open the trail map.
Preview the stops and replay the footprints. Pause, skip stops or change speed.
trail.detail: Dates → Photos → Map preview → Footprint replay
trail.focus: Map stops, footprint paths and playback controls

meet.title: Say what you’re after.
meet.accent: Let Meet help you find it.
meet.sub:
Find people, bars, parties or posts.
Speak or type, then review the criteria and results.
meet.focus: Your criteria and reasons to connect

tonight.eyebrow: WHAT TO DRINK / A LITTLE INSPIRATION
tonight.title: Can’t decide?
tonight.sub:
Reveal a drink category, or draw again.
Then find nearby bars and shops, or invite someone.
tonight.detail: Draw → Reveal → Find a place or invite
tonight.focus: A drink idea with somewhere to go

cheers.title: Like the moment?
cheers.sub:
Toast someone’s post.
See received and sent cheers, toast back and chat.
cheers.detail: Toast a post → Receive → Toast back or chat
cheers.focus: A record of every toast and reply

home.title: Start on the map.
home.sub:
The map connects posts, parties and nearby places.
Your profile brings check-ins, trails, saves and taste together.
home.detail: Home map → Your profile → Your memories
home.focus: Your profile, memories and taste in one place
